svg.title: A subtree consistency proof, tree of size 14
svg.desc: The tree of 14 entries: root [0,14) splits into [0,8) and [8,14); [8,14) into [8,12) and [12,14); [12,14) into entries 12 and 13. The subtree [8,13) is highlighted. Its proof is four hashes: entry 12 (inside the subtree, the starting point), entry 13 (a right sibling outside it), [8,12) (a left sibling inside it) and [0,8) (a left sibling outside it). From these the verifier rebuilds both the subtree hash and the root.

text.tspan: inside hashes rebuild the subtree; all four rebuild the root. The verifier checks both at once.
